subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window to a compact summary, and the requested behavior adds a new public config and lifecycle policy rather than fixing broken documented behavior.

options.title: Accept narrow default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned option that keeps the completed progress draft visible while preserving the current one-line collapse behavior as the default.

options.title: Keep current summary behavior
options.body: Decline full draft preservation for now and rely on the current compact retained summary after final delivery.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track checklist preservation as part of a broader structured progress-card API instead of a Telegram-only config knob.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned option that keeps the completed progress draft visible while preserving the current one-line collapse behavior as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest available routing candidate from current blame and adjacent shared progress-draft lifecycle history.
